title: Boston Foreign Credential Evaluation
description: Learn why foreign credential evaluation is used and explore document-by-document, course-by-course, and professional experience evaluations.
intro: AET’s expert Boston foreign credential evaluation has made it a lot easier for many international students to continue their education in the United States. Our credential evaluation services in Boston MA can take a lot of the worry and anxiety out of this major transition. Foreign credential evaluation in Boston MA from AET makes it possible for immigration (submit to USCIS), employment (submit to employer) and education purposes.

sections.title: Why Do People Need Boston Credential Evaluation Services?
paragraphs: Boston foreign credential evaluation is an indispensable service for thousands of international students each year. There are many variations among foreign educational systems. That can make it extremely difficult for U.S.-based educators to know how qualified a student is to enter domestic colleges. At AET, we are experts in providing credential evaluation services in Boston MA. We know how determine a student’s level of academic achievement and apply that to U.S. standards.

AET’s Boston foreign credential evaluation reports are timely, accurate and complete. We present them in a professional manner, helping to ensure you get the credit you deserve for the hard work you have performed. No matter what type of foreign credential evaluation in Boston MA you need, you can rest easy knowing we will deliver unsurpassed quality.

sections.title: Our Boston credential evaluation services include the following:
items: Document-by-document evaluation – This is a basic evaluation that is often needed for people immigrating to the U.S., or applying for jobs in the U.S.
Course-by-course evaluation – Our most complete report, this includes information on U.S. degree equivalency, grade point average, credits and more.
Professional experience – This evaluation helps those who worked during school potentially turn that experience into U.S. college credits.

closing: Get in touch with AET today to learn more about our Boston foreign credential evaluation.
